props.name: direction
props.description:
Which drag directions dismiss the toast. `horizontal` (default) lets the
user fling either way; `left` / `right` constrain it to one side.

props.name: duration
props.description: Snap-back / fling animation duration in ms.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Fraction of the toast width a drag must pass (without a flick) to dismiss.

props.name: velocityThreshold
props.description: px/s flick speed above which a release dismisses regardless of distance.
